capabilities: Colors folders with curated or custom palettes
Assigns icons through name-matching rules and icon packs
Syncs folder colors to tags, headings, outline and graph view
Sets per-item color, icon, radius and typography from a right-click menu
Hides sensitive files with ghost mode and a password lock
disambiguation: Not only folder colors: it also styles tags, headings, the outline pane and graph view.
extras: Icon packs are downloaded from the plugin settings; all processing is offline and no data is sent over the network. Beta builds can be installed through BRAT.
motivation: The author wanted to turn the file explorer from a plain text list into a vibrant, organized visual dashboard that is effortless to scan.
problem: A plain file explorer gives no visual cues, so large vaults are slow to scan and folders are hard to tell apart.

relations.evidence: Runs cleanly alongside the Notebook Navigator plugin without loading conflicts

summary: Styling plugin that colors folders, tags, headings, outline and graph view with palettes, and assigns icons by name rules.
